title: Privacy Policy — Sephiria Guide
description: Privacy policy for sephiria-guide.com: analytics, optional sign-in, cookies, and account data.
body:
This policy explains what sephiria-guide.com collects when you visit or choose to sign in.

What we collect

  • Analytics. The site uses Google Analytics 4 (via a first-party script) to understand aggregate traffic: page views, approximate location, device, and referrer. GA may set cookies or use similar storage.
  • Hosting logs. Cloudflare may process standard request logs (IP, user agent, URL) for security and delivery.

Optional account sign-in

You can browse every guide without an account. If you choose to sign in with Google, GitHub, or X, we store that provider's account identifier and the profile name and picture it makes available. We store an email only when the provider supplies one that is verified; X sign-in does not require or provide an email in this flow. We keep account records in Cloudflare KV and use a secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie to keep you signed in for up to 30 days. Logging out ends the current session. Accounts from different providers remain separate even when their email addresses match.

We use this information only to provide sign-in. We do not use account information for advertising or sell it. To request deletion of an account record, contact us through the contact page.

What we do not collect

  • No newsletter signup.
  • No payment data.
  • We do not sell personal information.

Advertising

Pages may include Google AdSense ads (publisher ca-pub-8359621843582672). Google and its partners may use cookies or similar storage to serve and measure those ads, including when an ad request runs. Authorized sellers are listed in ads.txt. See How Google uses information from sites that use their services.

Contact
